name: Kallow Fleece Jogger
description: Standard mid-weight fleece jogger with a drawstring waist, ribbed cuffs, and two side pockets. Comes in heather grey, black, and navy. Soft on the inside, pilled on the outside after a few washes — exactly what you'd expect. Ubiquitous in GLMZ's Tier 2 residential blocks.
what_it_says: You're off the clock, or you never really had a clock to begin with. Comfortable and completely unpretentious.
worn_by: anyone running errands in the block
story_hooks: The same model is sold under six different brand names — all from the same Goretek subsidiary factory.
A character recognizes someone from their old block purely from the distinctive faded logo on these joggers.

physical_description.visual_profile: A relaxed, comfortable jogger with a casual athleisure silhouette. The tapered leg and ribbed cuffs create a gathered ankle profile that reads distinctly mid-2220s streetwear. Worn with confidence by those who value function over flash.
physical_description.fit: Relaxed through the hip and thigh with a gentle taper at the ankle. The drawstring waist allows customizable fit. Moves with the body rather than constraining it—designed for movement and extended wear.
physical_description.primary_material: Mid-weight synthetic fleece blend, brushed cotton-analog composite. Soft thermal lining on interior, standard weave on exterior prone to natural pilling.
physical_description.texture: Interior: plush and downy fleece with warmth-retention properties. Exterior: standard weave that develops visible pilling after repeated wash cycles, creating a lived-in, broken-in aesthetic.
physical_description.color_scheme: Heather grey (primary), with black and navy colorway options. Neutral, non-reflective palette designed for urban anonymity.
physical_description.closures: Drawstring waist with metal aglets and friction-fit toggle. Side pockets with stitch-reinforced seams. No visible fasteners or tech integration.
distinctive_features: Ribbed ankle cuffs for tapered silhouette
Two deep side pockets for personal items
Expected pilling on exterior after regular washing
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 2 utilitarian—affordable, functional, mass-produced. Signals stable corporate residence or mid-level service sector employment.
physical_description.cultural_context: The uniform of GLMZ Tier 2 residential blocks. Worn by corporate middle-management, maintenance workers, medical technicians, and anyone prioritizing comfort during off-hours. No statement—just practicality.
physical_description.condition_typical: Broken-in and worn. Fresh pairs show clean exterior weave; after 10–15 wash cycles, visible pilling develops across hips and thighs. Drawstring may show fraying. Seams remain intact due to reinforcement.
